name: tejashmakwana/motionmaxxing
description: Measured motion rework skill for motion graphics, built on principles of weight, soft-land angle, snap-settle timing, and negative tracking, installed via a local requirements-check script.
install: git clone into the Claude skills directory, then run the local install.sh (checks Node 22+, Python 3.9+, ffmpeg, Chrome, and links or copies the folder into the skills directory)
